items.name: takes-public
items.description: Takes for Mac (gettakes.app): a free, open-source Mac app for talking-head videos. A teleprompter that follows your voice, camera and screen recording, and your agent (Claude Code, Codex or pi) writes the script, cuts the edit and drafts the posts through the takes MCP server. Apple silicon, macOS 15+. Shared as is.

items.name: yap-studio
items.description: The video editor you never have to learn. An agent in Claude Code edits your videos on your Mac, and you leave notes from your phone.

items.name: ai-video-skill
items.description: Make and edit videos with Claude Opus 5.5: a Claude Code skill for product films, ads, talking heads, explainers, montages and Reels/TikTok/Shorts, with Remotion, AI images and animation, ElevenLabs music and ffmpeg.

items.name: b-roll-skills
items.description: Add b-roll motion graphics to a talking-head video with your AI coding agent: word-timed transcript, line-by-line plan, graphics drawn from what is said, MP4 with the original sound.

items.name: ai-video-editing-skills
items.description: 41 free AI video editing skills for Claude Code and Codex: auto captions, cut pauses and retakes, B-roll, words behind you, colour grade, music. Edit Reels, Shorts and TikTok by asking. Runs on your own computer, nothing uploaded.

items.name: video-edit-skill
items.description: Drop your raw clips, type /video-edit, get a finished short-form video. Best takes, kinetic captions, words behind you, logos, UI demos, zooms, sound, grade. Local-first Claude Code + Codex skill.

items.name: jmcai-autoshot-skill
items.description: 从一段文案到一条口播成片：本地数字人口播视频流水线（配音→数字人→包装），三阶段都有自愈闭环。基于 JMCAI Comfypet 桌面端 + Remotion，无线上 API。

items.name: talkinghead
items.description: Turn a talking-head recording into a finished cut. An LLM judge you choose makes the edits; every cut is explained in a report. macOS, Linux, Windows (WSL2).

items.name: hermes-skills-showcase
items.description: Showcase of Hermes Agent skills for AI video automation, free-model routing and Windows optimization. Full version on Agensi.io.

items.name: glass-edit
items.description: A Claude skill that edits talking-head videos into polished vertical shorts: liquid-glass logo tiles, paper backgrounds, pop-out PiP, kinetic captions.
